changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE administration.users ADD COLUMN status varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'APPROVED', ADD COLUMN credentials_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN auth_provider varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LOCAL';
ALTER TABLE administration.users ADD CONSTRAINT ck_users_on_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'BLOCKED')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_users_on_auth_provider CHECK (auth_provider IN ('LOCAL', 'GOOGLE'));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE administration.users DROP CONSTRAINT ck_users_on_auth_provider, DROP CONSTRAINT ck_users_on_status, DROP COLUMN auth_provider, DROP COLUMN credentials_version, DROP COLUMN status;
